chapters.title: Non-Abelian Gauge Theories
chapters.curation_note: Fifteen parents preserve complete MIT, ETH, Skinner, Stanford, Chicago, and Cambridge arcs across curvature, gauge fixing, BRST, cohomology, and BV.

chapters.title: External Field Methods
chapters.curation_note: Eleven parents cover connected functionals, Legendre geometry, determinants, derivative expansions, dimensional transmutation, bilocal composite sources, and the complete Cambridge generating-functional, diagram, and split-independence arc.

chapters.title: Renormalization of Gauge Theories
chapters.curation_note: Eleven parents preserve the cohomological, background-field, counterterm-stability, group-theory, vacuum-polarization, and asymptotic-freedom chain, capped by a complete Cambridge QED Ward-identity problem.

chapters.title: Renormalization Group Methods
chapters.curation_note: Twelve parents retain five complementary RG source blocks and exact McGreevy phi-six and particle-potential/Weyl parents, covering flows, fixed points, exponents, and marginal corrections.

chapters.title: Spontaneously Broken Global Symmetries
chapters.curation_note: Eleven parents balance five source traditions with an exact McGreevy infrared-fluctuation problem, retaining vacuum geometry, soft limits, current algebra, chiral perturbation theory, anomalies, and two-dimensional Goldstone obstruction.

chapters.title: Operator Product Expansions
chapters.curation_note: Ten parents combine exact MIT and McGreevy OPE architectures with QCD sum rules, deep-inelastic structure, parton evolution, and renormalon cancellation; further microproblems would repeat their internal stages.

chapters.title: Spontaneously Broken Gauge Symmetries
chapters.curation_note: Ten parents begin with the complete Cambridge charge, Goldstone, and Abelian-Higgs arc and retain coherent treatments of gauge fixing, electroweak charges and precision tests, unification, and superconducting infrared physics.

chapters.title: Anomalies
chapters.curation_note: Twelve parents follow Fujikawa, spectral flow, descent, inflow, triangle routing, and matching, including complete McGreevy heat-kernel and Standard-Model anomaly parents and the complete MIT dimensional-regularization anomaly parent.

chapters.title: Extended Field Configurations
chapters.curation_note: Twenty parents keep classic defect, monopole, instanton, axion, and bounce investigations distinct, while complete McGreevy domain-wall and polyacetylene parents and complete Cambridge kink, nonlinear-Schrodinger, vortex-scattering, Skyrmion, and instanton parents provide a stronger sheet-style backbone without splitting any source problem.
